Tzeentch is a false God. When I hear Tzeentch's name, I'll be there. When a Tzeentch player is doing something that feels illegal, I'll be there. When a Tzeentch player pushed up their glasses to show off their big brain plan, I'll be there. When they say they still have outs, I'll definitely be there. We all need a friend when the Tzeentch players come to town, and with an Ossiarch Nexus, I will shield you from the horrors that they bring.
